title: optical illusion
text: optical illusion. I bought this pillow as a part of Christmas gift for my college bound niece.  She is a S'more's freak and I thought the "write on it" element might be fun for her and her college friends.  I have to say that I expected the pillow to be a square, but it is not.  It is more rectangle and diamond topped, the top peak is not quite stuffed enough so it puckers a bit... it LOOKS sort of like a square in person, more so in the photo for the ad posting.  It is a beautiful photo of a S'more, very realistic.  The material is nylon-like but is not shiny. It appears to be well made.  I think my niece is going to love it.
